name: Sharp Conservative Offset for Marching Cubes
definition: A technique to determine the sharp infimum offset $\sigma_\star$ for a grid-sampled 1-Lipschitz function $f$ on a regular grid with spacing $h$, such that for every $\sigma > \sigma_\star$, the true zero-level set $f^{-1}(0)$ is contained within the inside of the marching cubes mesh $\mathcal{M}_\sigma$ extracted at level $\sigma$. It solves the problem of ensuring strict containment of the true geometry in the extracted mesh for safety-critical applications like collision detection.
summary: Sharp Conservative Offset for Marching Cubes computes a minimal offset guaranteeing the extracted mesh strictly encloses the true zero-level set, ensuring safety for collision detection.
